page.notes: Running head and page number as printed. Words marked [?] are doubtful: "um" after "illo" is an unclear abbreviation, and "esse" is set in a worn, irregular form. The catchword "blemata" completes the hyphenated word "Pro-blemata" and stands alone at the right below the last line. Long s has been normalised to s, and u/v and i/j to the modern vowel and consonant forms.
